text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $79k with modest gains, while Ethereum and smaller caps are outpacing it slightly, suggesting some rotation into altcoins despite BTC's dominance staying elevated at 58.4%. The Fear & Greed index at 66 and rising indicates growing confidence, though the relatively flat 24-hour moves across majors and moderate $92B volume suggest conviction remains measured rather than euphoric. Overall, sentiment is shifting toward risk-on, but traders appear cautious about committing fresh capital at current levels.
